name: date-field
title: Date field
description: A date you can type: day, month and year as separate segments in your locale's order, stepping with the arrow keys, with an optional calendar button.
docs: value and onValueChange(iso, { valid }) speak ISO dates (2026-03-14), with an empty string while the date is incomplete or impossible. The order of the parts and the separator come from locale (en-US by default), and min and max are ISO dates. Digits move on by themselves, ArrowUp and ArrowDown step a part, Backspace clears it and a pasted date fills all three (a two-digit year is 20xx up to 68, 19xx from 69). An impossible date such as 31 February is explained once all three parts are filled. showCalendar adds a button that opens the Calendar in a popover under the field, name adds a hidden input with the ISO date, and labels renames the parts for another language. id goes on the first part, so a label's htmlFor focuses the field; name the whole group with aria-labelledby.
